hooks.command: PATPAT_PLUGIN_ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; PATPAT_PLUGIN_DATA="${PLUGIN_DATA:-${GROK_PLUGIN_DATA:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-}}}"; if [ -z "$PATPAT_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then echo 'Patpat hook error: PLUGIN_ROOT is missing.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ -z "$PATPAT_PLUGIN_DATA" ]; then echo 'Patpat hook error: PLUGIN_DATA is missing.' >&2; exit 2; fi; PATPAT_PY=; for PATPAT_CANDIDATE in python3 python; do PATPAT_CANDIDATE="$(command -v "$PATPAT_CANDIDATE")" && "$PATPAT_CANDIDATE" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 11))' >/dev/null 2>&1 && PATPAT_PY="$PATPAT_CANDIDATE" && break; done; if [ -z "$PATPAT_PY" ]; then echo 'Patpat hook error: python3 or python 3.11+ is required on PATH.' >&2; exit 127; fi; "$PATPAT_PY" "$PATPAT_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/scripts/patpat_loop_state.py"
